treatment.winner: THE FAUCET BEFORE THE WATER (comedian base)
grafts: dramatist: a tear-off calendar as the pressure clock, Dec 4 and Dec 7 the only circled pages, and the dog-door residents-only tag (MAY)
enthusiast: the residents-only option drawn as the one Alaska-first upside, valuable only if written down

explainer: tokenization drawn as a coat-check clerk (Marge) whose ticket is the record of who owns a stake, no coin or chart imagery, and the $20 million drawn as twenty fixed bags never scaled against anything or called idle
treatment.judge_reasoning: Two of three returned pitches independently reached a faucet or spigot before the water, because the angle is about order, not a verdict. A personified fixture with a want and nothing to pour is a neutral hero that implies no AI project the sources never name. The calendar gives the film a clock the viewer can check. The Test keeps the critic's card held unjoked. Showrunner synthesis, the scorer step was skipped because the pitches converged.

palette.sky: #8FA39A overcast pewter-sage lifting to pale straw #D8CFA3 at the horizon
palette.ground: #6B6A5E wet gravel lot with puddle glints
palette.hero: #C9A24B brushed brass, spent ONLY on Drip and his pipe fittings
palette.rulebook: #D8432F tomato red, spent ONLY on the Rulebook and circled calendar dates
palette.accent: #5EEAD0 fluorescent mint ONLY on the AI slip, the pitch
palette.mood: flat honest November overcast over a gravel lot, brass and mint where the question lives
palette.why: An Anchorage lot in November is gray gravel under cloud with spruce and mountains behind, so the world is honest. One gleaming brass object gives the eye a single place to follow.
palette.divergence: The last three films were raven dusk with lime (11-12), pink-gold ice fog with amber (11-11) and violet shore with vermilion (11-10). This is overcast pewter-sage gravel by day with brass, red and mint, no dusk, no lime, no pink-gold, no plum.

light.time_of_day: flat overcast day on the lot, paper-lit cutaways, one glowing mint slip, a hard cut to black
light.arc: overcast day to cool paper cutaways to the same overcast, the sign gaining a suffix each act
light.direction: soft top light from the cloud, brass lit by reflection of the sky, long soft shadows on gravel
light.depth_approach: lib/stage3d planes, spruce row and Chugach ridges in parallax behind the lot, a long pipe receding in perspective, stacked paper planes for the Dry Hearing

shape_language: PRIMARY axis: Drip's round eyes and curved neck against the long straight horizontal of the pipe to the horizon. SECONDARY: rectilinear paper, calendar pages and signs. WHY: a curved hopeful face at the end of a hard straight line is the image of a faucet before the water.

casting.hero: DRIP, a brass yard spigot with a face (local component in the episode file, handle brow, neck eyes), the declared hero and throughline, five states
casting.throughline: Drip: brand new and dry, plumbed in, tagged, cap off with the AI slip, polished and dry with the padlock key at his feet
supporting: BUCKET, a dented galvanized pail with a tired kind face, reaction shots, never a person or a named group
THE RULEBOOK, a three-ring binder with one eye, always arriving last
casting.net_new: none from the shelf, Drip, Bucket and Rulebook are local components in the episode file

motion_language: Drip leans toward whoever walks up, coughs dust, and his handle lifts like a brow. Signs swing on springs. Calendar pages tear with anticipation and fall. Bags thump with squash. The whole frame jolts only on the three board kicks.
